findings.title: Direct LLM API Key Access in Emergency Alert Summarizer

evidence.observation: Direct calls to call_gemini and call_mistral accessing GEMINI_API_KEY and MISTRAL_API_KEY bypassing the centralized model router.

proposed_action.description: Route emergency alert LLM inference through the centralized model router on port 8891 rather than calling third-party provider APIs directly.

findings.expected_benefit: Ensures unified fallback, telemetry, latency tracking, and credential abstraction.
findings.policy_decision_rationale: Category: router_bypass; Evidence strength: conclusive; Confidence: 0.90; Risk: medium; Automation: needs_signoff; Category reason: Router bypasses must be corrected by design review
